artist.name: Etham
artist.short_description: Etham — an Afterglow editorial selection for listeners exploring acoustic pop.
artist.biography: Etham is a UK singer-songwriter whose catalogue places expressive vocals and personal relationship writing at the forefront. His earlier releases include stripped-back versions of ‘12:45’, ‘Before I Lose My Mind’, and ‘Purpose’, while later material includes ‘You're the Reason’, ‘Waiting for You’ and ‘Still Can't Move On’. The recorded titles and collaborations are traceable through Spotify and music-service catalogues. In 2025, Etham discussed the mini-album Everything & Nothing in original interviews, describing songwriting as a way to process difficult emotions. He explained that ‘Still Can't Move On’ drew on a breakup he experienced in 2023, and recalled beginning the song from feelings that were still present much later. That direct account is especially useful for Afterglow's sourced song-explanation pages. Editorially, his work fits an acoustic and soul-tinged branch of emotional pop, connecting listeners who enjoy vulnerable ballads with the softer parts of contemporary singer-songwriter music. This stylistic placement should not be confused with a formally defined official genre or a claim about the meaning of every track.
